cases.explain: Лопатка is the grammatical subject of the sentence, so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: «Дарья Александровна, — сказал он краснея до корней ___», — до корней волос.
cases.translation: ...he said, blushing to the roots of his hair.
cases.explain: The preposition до always governs the Genitive case, so волосы becomes волос.

cases.translation: And this seemed unpleasant to Levin.
cases.explain: The verb показаться (to seem) governs the Dative case for the person to whom something seems a certain way.

cases.sentence: «Нет, постойте», — сказала она, схватывая его за ___.
cases.translation: "No, wait," she said, grabbing him by the sleeve.
cases.explain: The preposition за with a verb of grasping/seizing takes the Accusative case here.

cases.sentence: Казавшееся мертвым чувство оживало и завладевало ___ Левина.
cases.translation: The feeling that had seemed dead came alive and took possession of Levin's heart.
cases.explain: The verb завладевать (to take possession of) governs the Instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Что-то трогательное показалось Долли в его ___.
cases.translation: Something touching appeared to Dolly in his face.
cases.explain: The preposition в with a static location ("in his face") requires the Prepositional case.

reading.ru: «Китти пишет мне, что ничего так не желает, как уединение и спокойствие», — сказала Долли после наступившего молчания.
reading.question: What does Kitty write to Dolly that she wants more than anything?
reading.explain: Dolly says Kitty writes that she wants nothing so much as solitude and peace.

reading.ru: «Слава Богу, она совсем поправилась. Я никогда не верила, чтобы у нее была грудная болезнь».
reading.question: What does Dolly say about Kitty's health?
options: She is dying of a chest illness
She has fully recovered and never had a chest illness
She has gone abroad for treatment
She refuses to see a doctor
reading.correct: She has fully recovered and never had a chest illness
reading.explain: Dolly says Kitty has completely recovered and she never believed Kitty had a chest illness.

reading.ru: «Послушайте, Константин Дмитриевич», — сказала Дарья Александровна, улыбаясь свою добрую и несколько насмешливую улыбкой, «за что вы сердитесь на Китсе?»
reading.question: What does Dolly ask Levin?
options: Why he is angry at Kitty
Why he is selling his estate
reading.correct: Why he is angry at Kitty
reading.explain: Dolly, smiling, asks Levin why he is angry with Kitty.

reading.ru: «Знаете, что я делал предложение, и что мне отказано?» — проговорил Левин
reading.question: What did Levin do that was rejected?
options: He offered to publish a book
reading.explain: Levin says he made a proposal (of marriage) and was refused.

reading.ru: «Вот уж в этом вы ошибаетесь. Я не знала этого, хотя и догадывалась».
reading.question: What does Dolly say about her knowledge of the situation?
options: She had no idea and is shocked
She didn't know for certain but suspected it
reading.correct: She didn't know for certain but suspected it
reading.explain: Dolly says she is mistaken to be thought informed — she did not know, though she guessed.

reading.ru: Мне ее ужасно, ужасно жалко. Вы страдаете только от гордости.
reading.question: According to Dolly, what does Levin suffer from?
reading.explain: Dolly tells Levin he suffers only from pride.

reading.ru: Если б я вас не любила, — сказала Дарья Александровна, и слезы выступили ей на глаза
reading.question: What happens to Dolly as she speaks to Levin?
reading.explain: As Dolly speaks, tears come to her eyes.

reading.ru: Но девушка в положении ожидания с этим женским, девичьим стыдом, девушка, которая видит вас, мужчин, издалека, принимает все на слово.
reading.question: According to Dolly, how does a young woman in Kitty's position relate to men?
options: She takes everything on faith, seeing men only from a distance
reading.correct: She takes everything on faith, seeing men only from a distance
reading.explain: Dolly explains that a girl in waiting sees men from a distance and takes everything on trust.

reading.ru: «Да, выбор между мной и Воронским», — подумал Левин
reading.question: What does Levin realize the choice was between?
reading.explain: Levin thinks to himself that the choice was between him and Vronsky.

reading.ru: «Ах, гордость и гордость!» — сказала Дарья Александровна, как будто презирая его за низость этого чувства
reading.question: What does Dolly exclaim Levin's feeling is?
reading.explain: Dolly exclaims "Ah, pride and pride!", scorning him for the baseness of that feeling.

reading.ru: «В то время как вы делали предложение Китти, она именно была в том положении, когда она не могла отвечать. В ней было колебание. Колебание, вы или Вронский?»
reading.question: What was Kitty experiencing when Levin proposed, according to Dolly?
reading.explain: Dolly says Kitty was in a state where she could not answer, wavering between Levin and Vronsky.

reading.ru: «Дарья Александровна», — сказал он сухо, «я ценю вашу доверенность ко мне».
reading.question: How does Levin respond to Dolly's frankness with him?
options: He says he values her confidence, but coldly
reading.correct: He says he values her confidence, but coldly
reading.explain: Levin says dryly that he values her confidence in him.

reading.ru: Все равно, как у вас бы умер ребенок, а вам бы говорили, а вот он был бы такой и такой и мог бы жить, и вы бы на него радовались, а он умер, умер, умер!»
reading.question: What image does Levin use to describe his pain over the rejection?
options: A child who died after being imagined as alive
reading.correct: A child who died after being imagined as alive
reading.explain: Levin compares his pain to imagining a dead child who might have lived.

reading.ru: «Так вы не приедете к нам, когда Китти будет?» «Нет, не приеду».
reading.question: Will Levin come to Dolly's house when Kitty is visiting?
reading.explain: When asked if he will come when Kitty is there, Levin flatly says he will not.

reading.ru: «Зачем ты пришла, Таня?» — сказала Дарья Александровна по-французски, вошедшей девочке.
reading.question: In what language does Dolly speak to her daughter Tanya?
reading.explain: Dolly addresses Tanya in French, as the text states she spoke по-французски.

reading.ru: «И для чего она говорит по-французски с детьми?» – подумал он. «Как это неестественно и фальшиво.
reading.question: What does Levin think of Dolly speaking French with her children?
options: He finds it unnatural and false
He thinks it helps their education
reading.correct: He finds it unnatural and false
reading.explain: Levin thinks it is unnatural and false for Dolly to speak French with her children.

reading.ru: Гриша и Таня подрались за мячик.
reading.question: What causes the household disturbance near the end of the passage?
options: Grisha and Tanya fighting over a ball
reading.correct: Grisha and Tanya fighting over a ball
reading.explain: The text says Grisha and Tanya fought over a little ball, upsetting Dolly.
